title: ActionsBoard-Duo
description: An extension for keeping track of your CI. It shows CI build status as a tree (account = server → workflow/plan → run/build → job), with a summary in the status bar. Tokens are kept only in SecretStorage; polling is read-only, with no tracking.

title: P10 Project Manager
description: Save, tag, sort and quickly switch between projects from the sidebar, quick pick or status bar. Auto-detects Git repositories. Plain JSON storage, zero dependencies.

title: Cool Theme Kit (JetBrains Look)
description: JetBrains (PyCharm New UI) style theme for VS Code: file icons, colors and product icons, with other installed themes layered on top by priority

title: ZIP Prism
description: Inspect, search, and preview files inside ZIP archives directly in VS Code without extracting them.
